members.snippet: With addition of 61 more companies, the list now includes 214 businesses in 11 countries, most of them Israeli.

events.headline: India’s Cockroach movement joins opposition push to oust election chief

members.title: India’s Cockroach movement joins opposition push to oust election chief
members.snippet: India’s youth-led Cockroach Janta Party has joined opposition calls for election chief Gyanesh Kumar to resign.

events.headline: Families fleeing Yemen’s war face displacement, hunger and water shortages

members.title: Families fleeing Yemen’s war face displacement, hunger and water shortages
members.snippet: Fighting between Houthi and government-aligned forces forces families out of their homes in Yemen.
